record: Housing figures are for East Manchester township in York County.

In the ACS 2024 5-year table, East Manchester Township has 3370 housing units and a median year built of 1991. 6 percent were built in 1939 or earlier, 51 percent date from 1990 or later, 84 percent are detached, and 3 percent are attached. Those years date buildings in East Manchester Township. They do not date the shingles.

The climate station used for York County context is York 3 SSW Pump Station. Across 27 reporting years in 1991-2020, precipitation averages about 43.3 inches. Across 24 reporting years, snowfall averages about 21.6 inches. That station is not sitting on a East Manchester Township roof.
The largest hail size in the York County extract is 2.00 inches on May 14, 2010 at Starview. That row does not name East Manchester Township.

No National Register historic district was matched to East Manchester Township in the county list used here. That is not proof that East Manchester Township has no local review. No homeowners association was verified for the whole place, and this page does not invent a permit fee.
sources: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 2024 5-year (2020-2024), tables B25034, B25024, and B25035, via Census Reporter. Year built is the building, not the roof.
NOAA NCEI Storm Events Database, Pennsylvania county files, 2004-2025. A row names its own location. It does not rate every roof in the municipality.
NOAA Regional Climate Center ACIS. Means of annual precipitation and snowfall for reporting years in 1991-2020. The station is named in the record, and it is not a gauge on the house.

National Register of Historic Places county lists via the English Wikipedia listing pages. A National Register district is not a local ordinance and does not by itself require federal approval for a private reroof.
